title: Summoning altar
kicker: Roster and summoning · summon and fusion
hook: The **altar** is where you spend **souls** to pull new demons into the roster — pity is shown so you always know how close the next strong pull is.

blindSpots.meaning: The summon surface in the control room (Summon / Demons). Not a lawn plant, not a world-map building.
One spend of souls that adds a specimen. Costs are on screen — this guide does not invent numbers.
Progress toward a stronger result. Shown on the altar so the bank does not feel like a black box.
Random pulls for new demons. One intake path — [wild joins](wild-joins) and capture are others.

sections.title: What it is
paras: A soul sink that grows the roster.
You watch pity climb so strong pulls are readable, not hidden.

sections.title: How a pull feels
steps: Open the altar when you can afford a pull.
Confirm the spend — souls leave the bank with no refund.
Read the new specimen on Creatures.
diagram: play  ->  souls  ->  altar pull  ->  new specimen

sections.title: What the altar is not
paras: It is not the only way to get demons.
It is not Fusion (`F`) — fusion merges specimens you already have.

doSteps: Check souls on the HUD after a lawn match or other play.
Open Summon / Demons and read the pity and cost on screen.
Pull once when you can afford it, then open Creatures (`C`) to meet the new specimen.
doNote: Stop when altar ≠ fusion is clear. Bind next: [pacts and loyalty](pacts-loyalty).

mixUps.a: No. Essence is for fusion’s element gate. The altar spends souls.

mixUps.q: Can I refund a bad pull?
mixUps.a: No. Confirmed spends leave the bank.
No. It is shown on the altar on purpose.

mixUps.q: Must I pull forever to grow?
mixUps.a: No. Wild joins and other intakes exist — gacha is one path.
